title: Phone Before Sleep
hook: What if you scroll before bedtime?

beats.label: 30 MIN
beats.line: After thirty minutes, blue light slashes melatonin, leaving you wired.
beats.idea: Character holds phone, blue glow over brain, melatonin droplet shrinking

beats.label: 60 MIN
beats.line: At sixty minutes, your pulse spikes, drumming in your ears.
beats.idea: Cartoon heart thumps faster, pulse line spikes

beats.label: 120 MIN
beats.line: After two hours, brain waves stay shallow, pushing deep sleep farther away.
beats.idea: Brain shows light sleep waves, delta waves missing

beats.label: 240 MIN
beats.line: At four hours, cortisol spikes, leaving you jittery and unable to drift.
beats.idea: Cortisol icons rise, character tosses in bed

beats.label: 480 MIN
beats.line: At eight hours, you stumble awake, reaction time lagging behind.
beats.idea: Character yawns, sluggish reaction test gauge

description: A short animated guide showing how late-night phone use disrupts sleep.

facts.claim: Blue light from screens suppresses melatonin production
Screen use before bed can increase heart rate
Late-night screen exposure delays deep (slow-wave) sleep
Screen exposure before sleep raises cortisol levels, causing restlessness
Reduced deep sleep leads to morning grogginess and slower reaction time

end.line: Will you put the phone away?

topic: What happens if you check your phone before sleep?
